For example, if you were a size 8 in women's, you'd be a size 6.5 in men's. ... Please note, by design, our high performance skate shoes tend to fit snug, so you may want to select a half size larger. Alternatively, if you have a wide foot, you may purchase one size larger to compensate for the width

claim: Size chart: paper against the wall, heel to the wall, mark the longest toe, measure from the wall, both feet, compare with the chart (EU, UK, USA, Inch).
exact_words: Place a piece of paper that's larger than your foot against the wall. Stand with one foot on the paper, with your heel just up against the wall. Mark the end of your longest toe on the paper (you may need a friend to help) and measure from the wall to the marking. Do the same for the other foot and compare measurements with our size chart to get the right size!
notes: Chart header: EU | UK | USA | Inch; the inch column is not named the foot's.

claim: FAQ: trace with full weight, pencil upright, measure from the big toe to the centre back of the heel; line your foot measurements up with the boots' measurements.
exact_words: For the most accurate measurement, put your full weight on your foot and keep the pencil straight up and down. Measure your traced foot from the point of your big toe to the center back of your heel. ... Once you know how to measure boot size, all you need to do is line up your foot measurements with the measurements of our boots.
notes: Big toe here, longest toe on the chart page. help.timberland.com refused (TLS).
